# Notes search clearing fix

Clearing Search notes now restores Alpha and Beta. The original browser trigger failed before the edit and passed afterward on the same native Comet tab, URL, server process and unchanged fixture data. The production change adds `render(notes)` to the blank-query branch in `search-view.mjs`. Nonempty matching remains unchanged. The maintainer receives a focused caller regression, ordered patches and actual browser evidence.

## Revisions and ownership

The task repository is `<private-run>/work/notes_workflow_reruns/projects/reproduce-before-fix`.
